Hi Jane / Tom —

Thanks again for the quick close — excited to get Clearwell live. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a compact sprintchart for the post-signature window. This document embeds the rollout, canary, migration, and training cadence so we can run a coordinated handoff between Sales, Customer Success, and your engineering team.

Key asks from our side:
- Please confirm your preferred canary week (we propose Oct 8–12 OR Oct 15–19).
- Confirm training audience: ops (1 hour) + dev integration (2 hours) — suggested dates below.
- Any compliance or network whitelisting tasks we should add as MAP items (SOC2 evidence, IP ranges, SAML metadata).

Short summary of milestones in the attached MAP (clearwell_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) Kickoff & environment provision — target Sept 20–22
2) Canary (staged traffic) — target Oct 8–19 (2 waves)
3) Migration / cutover rehearsal — Sept 29–Oct 3
4) Training & runbooks — Sept 25–Oct 5
5) Go-live & hypercare — Oct 22–Nov 05

Links: MAP folder and runbook drafts are in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3rMAP-staging-clearwell
DocuSign reference for amendments: https://www.docusign.net/CL/Sign?doc=DEAL-CH-2028-117

Marcus will be the onboarding lead for Redwood; Karthik will own canary gating/metrics. Evelyn and I will coordinate the exec-level cadence and weekly sync.

Next steps: if you reply with the canary week preference and any additional security items, we’ll finalize the MAP and post the schedule to the shared folder.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Quick internal notes and a proposed gating plan to add to the MAP (I’ll update the spreadsheet after Jane confirms):
- Move canary to Oct 8–12 (agreed by Jane) and run a second small wave Oct 15–16 as safety (no heavy traffic).
- Canary gating metrics (pass criteria): error rate < 0.5% 95th pct latency < 350ms for the baseline profile, and no regression on our sample prompt-sets (we’ll push the eval harness).
- Migration rehearsal should be Sept 29 (ops-only) with a full dry-run Oct 6 (inc. DB snapshots and fallback). Avoid rehearsals on the internal maintenance window Tom called out (we’ll coordinate).
- Training: ops on Sept 26 (45–60m), dev integration on Oct 2 (90–120m). Recommend recording the dev session and capturing a short runbook.

Marcus will be the primary onboarding owner and point of contact for runbook delivery. Evelyn, please add the executive-level acceptance gate on Oct 20 (sign-off to move to go-live).
